text.text: Your clinic on one page. Start with Appointments for today, then Vaccines to call owners whose reminders are due, and use Pets and Owners for the people and animals behind every visit. Operational tracking only; medical records stay in your clinical system.
Reminders are how a clinic keeps animals protected and the schedule full.
Open Vaccines and look at the Next 30 days view.
Message each owner by their preferred method and mark the record Reminder sent.
When they book, link the visit and mark the record Booked.
Call owners with Lapsed records and offer the next opening.
Log the call on the record.
Greet the owner and confirm the pet's name and reason.
Press Check in so the vet sees who is waiting.
Confirm phone number and preferred reminders.
Book the follow-up or next wellness exam before the owner leaves.
Add any vaccines given under Vaccines with the next due date.
A short, consistent script keeps emergencies from waiting. Decisions on care belong to the vet.
Pet name, species, age and owner's phone.
What is happening and for how long.
Whether the pet is eating, drinking and moving as usual.
If the owner describes an emergency, put them through to the vet on duty at once.
Otherwise book the earliest Sick visit and note the call on the appointment.
Print the schedule for exam rooms
Mark every visit Completed or No-show
Book follow-ups before the owner leaves
